newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia congratulates Clinton on victory.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia congratulates Clinton on victory.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd on Wednesday congratulated U.S. President Bill Clinton on his election victory, affirming both countries' desire to promote peace and stability in the Middle East.

"I am very delighted to send you hearty congratulations in the name of the people and the government of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as well as myself," King Fahd said in a cable carried by the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA).

"It gives me pleasure to confirm on this occasion the close, historical ties between our two friendly countries and our mutual desire to strengthen them and establish peace, security and stability in the Middle East," the king said.
Saudi Arabia is a key U.S. ally in the Middle East and is a top oil supplier to the United States. Up to 40,000 Americans live and work in the kingdom.
